0.content:
<%_
const _tkv2Payload = getvar('true_king_v2.prompt_payload', { scope: 'local' });
let _tkv2Content = '';
const _tkv2HasPayload = _tkv2Payload?.schemaVersion === 2;

// 真王核心v2的固定世界书只发布组合内核已经生成并校验的提示词产物。
// 它不读取编制、不判断角色、不重新拼装，也不接触前端愿望清单。
if (_tkv2HasPayload) {
  if (_tkv2Payload.status !== 'ready') {
    throw new Error(`[真王核心v2] 本轮世界书尚未就绪：${_tkv2Payload.error || _tkv2Payload.status || 'unknown'}`);
  }
  if (_tkv2Payload.producer !== 'true-king-composition-v2') {
    throw new Error('[真王核心v2] 世界书载荷来源不受信任。');
  }
  if (typeof _tkv2Payload.content !== 'string' || !_tkv2Payload.content.includes('<荆棘冠冕>') || !_tkv2Payload.content.includes('</荆棘冠冕>')) {
    throw new Error('[真王核心v2] 拼装结果不符合荆棘冠冕基底格式。');
  }
  if (_tkv2Payload.content.includes('[[TKC_REGION:')) {
    throw new Error('[真王核心v2] 拼装结果仍含未处理区域。');
  }
  _tkv2Content = _tkv2Payload.content;
}
_%><%- _tkv2Content %>
